description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken Monk], [Damage Cap +10000], [Rousing Charge Mode (Fire, Lightning, Earth)] and [Rousing Rush Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Monk
description.text: Monk abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Monk abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Rousing Charge Mode (Fire, Lightning, Earth)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Lightning]/[Attach Earth] after using a Fire/Lightning/Earth ability

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Rousing Rush Mode
description.text: ATK +50%, DEF and RES -30%, 50% chance for Monk abilities to trigger 1 additional time
